subject: maths
question: Raju can do a piece of work in 10 hours and Ram can do it in 15 hours. In how much time will they finish the whole work working together?
solution:
**Given:**

Raju can complete the work in 10 hours

Ram can complete the same work in 15 hours

**Concept:**

When two people work together, their combined rate is the sum of their individual rates.

**Solution:**

⇒ Work done by Raju in 1 hour = 1/10

⇒ Work done by Ram in 1 hour = 1/15

⇒ Combined work done in 1 hour = (1/10) + (1/15) = 1/6

⇒ Time required to finish the work = 1/(Combined work done in 1 hour) = 6 hours

**Therefore, Raju and Ram can finish the work together in 6 hours.**
